knowledge.text: The added examine-in-light desklamp section did produce a behavior difference from the un-edited Parent in one observed examine pair, train:0002 (look at cd under the desklamp): whereas the Candidate went from shelf 1 (Q3:4) straight to shelf 2 (Q3:5) and used the desklamp (Q3:6), the Parent returned to desk 1 (P3:5) — whose observation then showed only an alarmclock and a keychain, no desklamp — between shelf 1 (P3:4) and shelf 2 (P3:6) before using the desklamp (P3:7), giving 7 vs 6 actions with both runs successful. This divergence matches the examine-specific clause against returning to the desklamp-less location where the goal object had been acquired. In the other observed examine pairs, where no desklamp was present where the object was taken, Parent and Candidate behaved identically (take the object, then navigate to the desklamp and use it immediately) with equal action counts (train:0000 and train:0001: 4 vs 4; train:0003: 4 vs 4). Where a desklamp was visible at the location where the object was taken (train:0004), both Parent (P5:26, P5:27) and Candidate (Q5:2, Q5:3) used it immediately without relocating the object. Thus the only observed paired difference is the Candidate's one-step-shorter route in train:0002, and both agents succeeded in every pair.
